# GoBrand Calendar

> Complete documentation for @gobrand/react-calendar and @gobrand/calendar-core.

# React Calendar

> Month, week, and day calendars for React, built on Temporal.

Canonical: https://calendar.gobrand.app/docs

You bring the markup and styles. Calendar handles the date, the view, navigation, the timezone, and where each event goes.

```tsx
import type { Temporal } from '@js-temporal/polyfill'
import { useCreateCalendar } from '@gobrand/react-calendar'

type Booking = {
  id: string
  guest: string
  date: Temporal.PlainDate
}

function BookingCalendar({ bookings }: { bookings: Booking[] }) {
  const calendar = useCreateCalendar({
    views: { month: true },
    items: bookings,
    getDate: booking => booking.date,
  })

  return calendar.activeView.weeks.map(week => (
    <div key={week[0].id}>
      {week.map(day => (
        <div key={day.id}>
          {day.date.day}: {day.items.map(booking => booking.guest).join(', ')}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  ))
}
```

Only `month` is enabled, so `activeView` is a month. Add `week` or `day` when you need them.

[Build your first calendar](/docs/first-calendar) or [see month, week, and day together](/docs/examples/multi-view).

---

# Installation

> Install GoBrand React Calendar.

Canonical: https://calendar.gobrand.app/docs/installation

```bash
pnpm add @gobrand/react-calendar @js-temporal/polyfill
```

It includes the core package and its types, and works with React 18 and 19.

Import `Temporal` from the polyfill:

```typescript
import { Temporal } from '@js-temporal/polyfill';

const launch = Temporal.PlainDate.from('2026-07-10');
const standup = Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from('2026-07-10T09:00[Europe/Madrid]');
```

---

# Your first calendar

> Build a month calendar with navigation in one hook.

Canonical: https://calendar.gobrand.app/docs/first-calendar

Turn on a view, pass your events, and say which date each event is on.

```tsx
import type { Temporal } from '@js-temporal/polyfill'
import { useCreateCalendar } from '@gobrand/react-calendar'

type Event = {
  id: string
  title: string
  date: Temporal.PlainDate
}

function Calendar({ events }: { events: Event[] }) {
  const calendar = useCreateCalendar({
    views: { month: true },
    items: events,
    getDate: event => event.date,
  })

  return (
    <section>
      <button onClick={calendar.previous}>Previous</button>
      <h2>{calendar.title()}</h2>
      <button onClick={calendar.next}>Next</button>
      {calendar.activeView.weeks.flat().map(day => (
        <div key={day.id}>
          {day.date.toString()}: {day.items.map(event => event.title).join(', ')}
        </div>
      ))}
    </section>
  )
}
```

TypeScript infers `Event` from `items`, and `activeView` is a month because month is the only view.

[Complete basic-month source](https://calendar.gobrand.app/examples/basic-month.md) (export `BasicMonthExample`).

The calendar keeps the date and view, moves with `previous()`, `next()`, and `today()`, gives you a localized `title()`, and builds the grid. Your app owns the markup, styles, and data fetching.

## Events with a start time

If your events have a `Temporal.ZonedDateTime` start, give `getDate` the date part:

```tsx
const calendar = useCreateCalendar({
  views: { month: true, week: true, day: true },
  timeZone: 'Europe/Madrid',
  items: events,
  getDate: event => event.startsAt.withTimeZone('Europe/Madrid').toPlainDate(),
  getStart: event => event.startsAt.withTimeZone('Europe/Madrid'),
})
```

`getStart` places events in the week and day time slots. Convert to the calendar's timezone first, so an event at 23:30 UTC lands on the right local day. More in [timezones](/docs/timezones-and-ranges).

[See month, week, and day together](/docs/examples/multi-view).

---

# Data and Suspense

> Keep calendar controls available while a view loads its events.

Canonical: https://calendar.gobrand.app/docs/data-and-suspense

Create the calendar without events above the Suspense boundary. Fetch and project the events inside the view.

```tsx
import { Suspense } from 'react'
import type { Temporal } from '@js-temporal/polyfill'
import { useSuspenseQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import {
  CalendarProvider,
  useCalendar,
  useCalendarView,
  useCreateCalendar,
} from '@gobrand/react-calendar'

type Event = {
  id: string
  title: string
  date: Temporal.PlainDate
}

type CalendarProps = {
  loadEvents(
    start: Temporal.ZonedDateTime,
    end: Temporal.ZonedDateTime,
  ): Promise<Event[]>
}

function Calendar({ loadEvents }: CalendarProps) {
  const calendar = useCreateCalendar({ views: { month: true } })

  return (
    <CalendarProvider calendar={calendar}>
      <Controls />
      <Suspense fallback={<p>Loading events…</p>}>
        <MonthView loadEvents={loadEvents} />
      </Suspense>
    </CalendarProvider>
  )
}

function Controls() {
  const calendar = useCalendar()

  return (
    <nav>
      <button onClick={calendar.previous}>Previous</button>
      <strong>{calendar.title()}</strong>
      <button onClick={calendar.next}>Next</button>
    </nav>
  )
}

function MonthView({ loadEvents }: CalendarProps) {
  const calendar = useCalendar()
  const { start, end } = calendar.visibleRange
  const { data: events } = useSuspenseQuery({
    queryKey: ['events', start.toString(), end.toString()],
    queryFn: () => loadEvents(start, end),
  })

  const month = useCalendarView({
    view: 'month',
    items: events,
    getDate: event => event.date,
  })

  return month.weeks.map(week => (
    <div key={week[0].id}>
      {week.map(day => (
        <div key={day.id}>
          {day.date.toString()}: {day.items.map(event => event.title).join(', ')}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  ))
}
```

`Controls` does not unmount when `MonthView` suspends, so navigation remains available while events load.
The example assumes your app already has TanStack Query's `QueryClientProvider`.

## Different data for each view

Each `useCalendarView` call infers its own item type. A month view can use summaries while a timed week view uses full event records. The shared controller does not need to know either type.

[Complete suspense-month source](https://calendar.gobrand.app/examples/suspense-month.md) (export `SuspenseMonthExample`).

---

# Timezones and visible ranges

> Show the right day in every timezone and query exactly what is on screen.

Canonical: https://calendar.gobrand.app/docs/timezones-and-ranges

Set the timezone once:

```tsx
const calendar = useCreateCalendar({
  views: { month: true, week: true },
  timeZone: 'America/New_York',
})
```

It decides the starting date, `today()`, `isToday`, and the visible range. Leave it out to use the device's timezone; set it when rendering on a server or showing someone else's calendar.

## Query what is on screen

`visibleRange` covers every date in the current view. Include `start`, exclude `end`:

```ts
const { start, end } = calendar.visibleRange

await db.event.findMany({
  where: {
    startsAt: { gte: start.toInstant(), lt: end.toInstant() },
  },
})
```

Both are local midnights, so a day that daylight saving makes 23 or 25 hours long is still exactly one day.

## Put events on the right day

The calendar's timezone does not convert your events. Convert each one to that timezone, then read the date and start from the same value:

```ts
import { Temporal } from '@js-temporal/polyfill';

const meeting = {
  title: 'Sync with Tokyo',
  start: Temporal.Instant.from('2026-07-10T23:30:00Z').toZonedDateTimeISO('Europe/Madrid'),
};
const getDate = (event: typeof meeting) => event.start.toPlainDate();
const getStart = (event: typeof meeting) => event.start;
// getDate(meeting).toString() === '2026-07-11'
// getStart(meeting).hour === 1
```

In UTC the meeting is on July 10. In a Madrid calendar it is on July 11 at 01:30, and that is where it shows up.

---

# Controlled state and routing

> Keep the calendar's date and view in the URL or your own state.

Canonical: https://calendar.gobrand.app/docs/controlled-state

Pass `date` and `view` to control them, like a React input. Use `defaultDate` and `defaultView` to set only the starting values.

| State | Controlled | Starting value only |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Date | `date` / `onDateChange` | `defaultDate` |
| View | `view` / `onViewChange` | `defaultView` |

```tsx
const calendar = useCreateCalendar({
  views: { month: true, week: true },
  date: search.date,
  view: search.view,
  onDateChange: date => navigate({ search: previous => ({ ...previous, date }) }),
  onViewChange: view => navigate({ search: previous => ({ ...previous, view }) }),
})
```

The calendar follows the props right away, so the browser's back and forward buttons just work.

## Use the current calendar

`useCreateCalendar` can return a new calendar object after a render, for example when the date, view, or timezone changes. Read it and its actions from the current render. To subscribe, depend on it:

```tsx
useEffect(() => calendar.subscribe(() => {
  console.log(calendar.date.toString());
}), [calendar]);
```

---

# useCreateCalendar

> Create a calendar in a component, with or without its events.

Canonical: https://calendar.gobrand.app/docs/api/use-create-calendar

```tsx
const calendar = useCreateCalendar({
  views: { month: true, week: true },
  defaultDate: Temporal.PlainDate.from('2026-07-10'),
  defaultView: 'month',
  timeZone: 'America/Asuncion',
  items: events,
  getDate: event => event.date,
})
```

With `items`, the result also has `activeView`, the current month, week, or day with your events on it. Without `items`, pass the calendar to `CalendarProvider` and build views with [`useCalendarView`](/docs/api/use-calendar-view).

| Option | |
| --- | --- |
| `views` | Required. `{ month: true }`, or `{ week: { dayStart, dayEnd, slotDuration } }` for custom hours. |
| `defaultDate`, `defaultView` | Starting values. |
| `date`, `onDateChange`, `view`, `onViewChange` | [Controlled state](/docs/controlled-state). |
| `timeZone` | IANA name. Defaults to the device timezone. |
| `weekStartsOn` | `1` (Monday) through `7` (Sunday). Defaults to the locale's first day. |
| `items`, `getDate`, `getStart` | Your events and where each one goes. |

Use the calendar from the current render; it can change between renders. When rendering on the server, pass the same `date`, `view`, and `timeZone` on the server and the client.

---

# useCalendar

> Read the calendar from CalendarProvider.

Canonical: https://calendar.gobrand.app/docs/api/use-calendar

```tsx
function Toolbar() {
  const calendar = useCalendar()
  return (
    <button onClick={calendar.next}>{calendar.title()}</button>
  )
}
```

The component re-renders when the date or view changes. Event types belong to [`useCalendarView`](/docs/api/use-calendar-view), so `useCalendar` takes none.

You can also pass a calendar made with core `createCalendar` to the provider. Create it once, for example in `useState`, not on every render.

---

# useCalendarView

> Put events into one view of a shared calendar.

Canonical: https://calendar.gobrand.app/docs/api/use-calendar-view

`useCalendarView` reads the calendar from `CalendarProvider`, or from a `calendar` you pass. TypeScript infers the event type from `items`.

```tsx
import type { Temporal } from '@js-temporal/polyfill'
import { useCalendarView } from '@gobrand/react-calendar'

type Meeting = {
  id: string
  title: string
  startsAt: Temporal.ZonedDateTime
}

function WeekContent({ meetings }: { meetings: Meeting[] }) {
  const week = useCalendarView({
    view: 'week',
    items: meetings,
    getDate: meeting => meeting.startsAt.toPlainDate(),
    getStart: meeting => meeting.startsAt,
  })

  return week.days.map(day => (
    <div key={day.id}>
      {day.date.toString()}: {day.items.map(meeting => meeting.title).join(', ')}
    </div>
  ))
}
```

`getDate` is required with `items`. Add `getStart` to place events in time slots. The view you ask for is the view you get: `view: 'week'` stays a week even when the calendar switches to month.

---

# CalendarProvider

> Share one calendar with the components below it.

Canonical: https://calendar.gobrand.app/docs/api/calendar-provider

```tsx
import {
  CalendarProvider,
  useCalendar,
  useCreateCalendar,
} from '@gobrand/react-calendar'

function Calendar() {
  const calendar = useCreateCalendar({ views: { month: true } })

  return (
    <CalendarProvider calendar={calendar}>
      <Controls />
      <VisibleRange />
    </CalendarProvider>
  )
}

function Controls() {
  const calendar = useCalendar()

  return (
    <nav>
      <button onClick={calendar.previous}>Previous</button>
      <strong>{calendar.title()}</strong>
      <button onClick={calendar.next}>Next</button>
    </nav>
  )
}

function VisibleRange() {
  const { visibleRange } = useCalendar()

  return <p>{visibleRange.start.toString()} – {visibleRange.end.toString()}</p>
}
```

The provider shares the date and view, not events. Each view below it can load its own data.

---

# Types

> The shapes you render, from the calendar to its days and time slots.

Canonical: https://calendar.gobrand.app/docs/types

All types are exported from both `@gobrand/react-calendar` and `@gobrand/calendar-core`. `TItem` is your event type, inferred from `items`.

```ts
import type { Temporal } from '@js-temporal/polyfill';

type VisibleRange = {
  start: Temporal.ZonedDateTime; // included
  end: Temporal.ZonedDateTime; // excluded
};

type MonthView<TItem> = {
  name: 'month';
  month: Temporal.PlainYearMonth;
  weeks: Array<
    Array<{
      id: string;
      date: Temporal.PlainDate;
      isCurrentMonth: boolean;
      isToday: boolean;
      items: TItem[];
    }>
  >;
};

type TimeSlot<TItem> = {
  id: string;
  time: Temporal.PlainTime;
  hour: number;
  minute: number;
  items: TItem[];
};

type WeekView<TItem> = {
  name: 'week';
  weekStart: Temporal.PlainDate;
  weekEnd: Temporal.PlainDate;
  days: Array<{
    id: string;
    date: Temporal.PlainDate;
    isToday: boolean;
    items: TItem[];
    timeSlots: TimeSlot<TItem>[];
  }>;
};

type DayView<TItem> = {
  name: 'day';
  id: string;
  date: Temporal.PlainDate;
  isToday: boolean;
  items: TItem[];
  timeSlots: TimeSlot<TItem>[];
};
```

With more than one view enabled, `activeView` is a union of those views. Check `activeView.name` to render the right one. Each view also has a `view` field with the same value; prefer `name`.

`CalendarController` holds `date`, `view`, `viewNames`, `visibleRange`, `title()`, `next()`, `previous()`, `today()`, `setDate()`, `setView()`, and `subscribe()`.

# Calendar Core

> Month, week, and day calendars without a framework.

Canonical: https://calendar.gobrand.app/docs/core

Create a calendar, then build the view you want to render from your own data.

```ts
import { Temporal } from '@js-temporal/polyfill';
import { buildMonthView, createCalendar } from '@gobrand/calendar-core';

const bookings = [
  { id: 'b1', guest: 'Ana', date: Temporal.PlainDate.from('2026-07-10') },
  { id: 'b2', guest: 'Leo', date: Temporal.PlainDate.from('2026-07-24') },
];

const calendar = createCalendar({
  views: { month: true },
  date: Temporal.PlainDate.from('2026-07-10'),
  timeZone: 'Europe/Madrid',
  weekStartsOn: 1,
});

const month = buildMonthView({ calendar, items: bookings, getDate: (booking) => booking.date });

calendar.title('en-US'); // "July 2026"
month.weeks.length; // 5
month.weeks[1][4].items.map((booking) => booking.guest); // ["Ana"]
```

Without `date` and `timeZone`, the calendar starts on today in the device's timezone.

Next: [createCalendar](/docs/core/create-calendar), [view projections](/docs/core/projections), and [visible ranges](/docs/core/visible-ranges).

---

# Installation

> Install GoBrand Calendar Core.

Canonical: https://calendar.gobrand.app/docs/core/installation

```bash
pnpm add @gobrand/calendar-core @js-temporal/polyfill
```

Types are included. Import `Temporal` from the polyfill and pass Temporal values to the calendar:

```ts
import { Temporal } from '@js-temporal/polyfill';

const launch = Temporal.PlainDate.from('2026-07-10');
const standup = Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from('2026-07-10T09:00[Europe/Madrid]');
```

Using React? Install [`@gobrand/react-calendar`](/docs/installation) instead; it includes the core package.

---

# createCalendar

> Create a calendar with its date, view, timezone, and navigation.

Canonical: https://calendar.gobrand.app/docs/core/create-calendar

```ts
import { Temporal } from '@js-temporal/polyfill';
import { createCalendar } from '@gobrand/calendar-core';

const calendar = createCalendar({
  views: {
    month: true,
    week: {
      dayStart: Temporal.PlainTime.from('08:00'),
      dayEnd: Temporal.PlainTime.from('18:00'),
      slotDuration: Temporal.Duration.from({ minutes: 30 }),
    },
  },
  date: Temporal.PlainDate.from('2026-07-10'),
  timeZone: 'America/New_York',
  weekStartsOn: 7,
});

calendar.view; // "month"
calendar.next();
calendar.date.toString(); // "2026-08-10"
calendar.setView('week');
calendar.title('en-US'); // "Aug 9 - Aug 15, 2026"
```

| Option | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `views` | Required. Enable a view with `true`, or pass `dayStart`, `dayEnd`, and `slotDuration` for week and day. Leave a view out to disable it. |
| `date` | Today in `timeZone`. A `Temporal.PlainDate`. |
| `view` | The first view in `views`. |
| `timeZone` | The device timezone. An IANA name such as `'Europe/Madrid'`. |
| `weekStartsOn` | The locale's first day. `1` is Monday through `7` is Sunday. |

The calendar has `date`, `view`, `visibleRange`, `title()`, `next()`, `previous()`, `today()`, `setDate()`, `setView()`, and `subscribe()`.

Inputs of the wrong type throw a `TypeError` that names what you passed, for example `date must be a Temporal.PlainDate, got String`.

---

# View Projections

> Turn the calendar and your data into month, week, or day views.

Canonical: https://calendar.gobrand.app/docs/core/projections

`buildMonthView`, `buildWeekView`, and `buildDayView` place your items on dates. Each call takes its own items, so a month of booking counts and a week of full meetings can share one calendar.

```ts
import { Temporal } from '@js-temporal/polyfill';
import { buildWeekView, createCalendar } from '@gobrand/calendar-core';

const meetings = [
  {
    title: 'Design review',
    start: Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from('2026-07-08T10:30[Europe/Madrid]'),
  },
];

const calendar = createCalendar({
  views: { week: true },
  date: Temporal.PlainDate.from('2026-07-08'),
  timeZone: 'Europe/Madrid',
  weekStartsOn: 1,
});

const week = buildWeekView({
  calendar,
  items: meetings,
  getDate: (meeting) => meeting.start.toPlainDate(),
  getStart: (meeting) => meeting.start,
});

week.weekStart.toString(); // "2026-07-06"
week.days[2].items.length; // 1
week.days[2].timeSlots[10].items[0].title; // "Design review"
```

- `getDate` returns the `Temporal.PlainDate` an item belongs to. It is required when you pass `items`.
- `getStart` returns a `Temporal.ZonedDateTime` and places the item in a time slot. Add it for week and day views with timed events.
- Without `items`, you get the empty grid, which is all a date picker needs.

The calendar's timezone does not convert your items. Convert each event to that timezone first, then derive both accessors from it; see [timezones](/docs/timezones-and-ranges).

---

# Visible ranges

> The start and end to query for the dates on screen.

Canonical: https://calendar.gobrand.app/docs/core/visible-ranges

`visibleRange` covers every date the current view shows, including the leading and trailing days of a month grid.

```ts
import { Temporal } from '@js-temporal/polyfill';
import { createCalendar } from '@gobrand/calendar-core';

const calendar = createCalendar({
  views: { month: true },
  date: Temporal.PlainDate.from('2026-03-15'),
  timeZone: 'America/New_York',
  weekStartsOn: 7,
});

const { start, end } = calendar.visibleRange;
start.toString(); // "2026-03-01T00:00:00-05:00[America/New_York]"
end.toString(); // "2026-04-05T00:00:00-04:00[America/New_York]"
```

Include `start` and exclude `end`:

```sql
WHERE starts_at >= :start AND starts_at < :end
```

Both are local midnights in the calendar's timezone, so a day that daylight saving makes 23 or 25 hours long is still one day. Use `.toInstant()` when your database stores UTC.

---

# Utilities

> Weekday labels for calendar headers, and the Temporal one-liners for everything else.

Canonical: https://calendar.gobrand.app/docs/core/utilities

## getWeekdays

Weekday names in the order your calendar shows them. `1` starts on Monday, `7` on Sunday.

```ts
import { getWeekdays } from '@gobrand/calendar-core';

getWeekdays(); // ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]
getWeekdays(7); // ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"]
getWeekdays(1, 'es-ES', 'long'); // ["lunes", "martes", "miércoles", "jueves", "viernes", "sábado", "domingo"]
getWeekdays(7, 'en-US', 'narrow'); // ["S", "M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S"]
```

Use the calendar's `weekStartsOn` so the header matches the grid.

## Everything else is Temporal

Calendar has no other helpers. Temporal already does the rest in one line:

| Task | Temporal |
| --- | --- |
| Month name | `month.toLocaleString('en-US', { month: 'long' })` |
| Time label | `time.toLocaleString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })` |
| Device timezone | `Temporal.Now.timeZoneId()` |
| Show a meeting in another timezone | `meeting.withTimeZone('Asia/Tokyo')` |
| Date and time to a meeting | `date.toZonedDateTime({ timeZone, plainTime: time })` |
| Next month, last week | `date.add({ months: 1 })`, `date.subtract({ weeks: 1 })` |

For formatting and arithmetic with date-fns names, see [Tiempo](https://tiempo.gobrand.app).

---

# Example sources

All files below belong in the same directory. CSS classes are optional. The Suspense bootstrap supplies a stable QueryClientProvider.

- basic-month: BasicMonthExample in basic-month.tsx. Dependencies: @gobrand/react-calendar@*, @js-temporal/polyfill@0.5.1, react@19, tailwind-merge@^3.3.1, react-dom@19.
- date-picker: DatePickerExample in date-picker.tsx. Dependencies: @gobrand/react-calendar@*, @js-temporal/polyfill@0.5.1, react@19, tailwind-merge@^3.3.1, react-dom@19.
- simple-week: SimpleWeekExample in week-view.tsx. Dependencies: @gobrand/react-calendar@*, @js-temporal/polyfill@0.5.1, react@19, tailwind-merge@^3.3.1, react-dom@19.
- week-slots: WeekSlotsExample in week-view.tsx. Dependencies: @gobrand/react-calendar@*, @js-temporal/polyfill@0.5.1, react@19, tailwind-merge@^3.3.1, react-dom@19.
- day-view: DayViewExample in day-view.tsx. Dependencies: @gobrand/react-calendar@*, @js-temporal/polyfill@0.5.1, react@19, tailwind-merge@^3.3.1, react-dom@19.
- multi-view: MultiViewExample in multi-view.tsx. Dependencies: @gobrand/react-calendar@*, @js-temporal/polyfill@0.5.1, react@19, tailwind-merge@^3.3.1, react-dom@19.
- suspense-month: SuspenseMonthExample in suspense-month.tsx; mount StandaloneSuspenseMonth from suspense-standalone.tsx. Dependencies: @gobrand/react-calendar@*, @js-temporal/polyfill@0.5.1, react@19, tailwind-merge@^3.3.1, @tanstack/react-query@^5.90.0, react-dom@19.

### basic-month.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { useCreateCalendar } from '@gobrand/react-calendar';
import {
  Calendar,
  CalendarCell,
  CalendarEvent,
  CalendarGrid,
  CalendarRow,
  CalendarToolbar,
  CalendarWeekdays,
} from './calendar-ui';
import { accessor, events } from './mock-data';

export function BasicMonthExample() {
  const calendar = useCreateCalendar({
    views: { month: true },
    items: events,
    getDate: accessor.getDate,
  });
  const month = calendar.activeView;

  return (
    <Calendar size="month">
      <CalendarToolbar
        title={calendar.title()}
        previousLabel="Previous month"
        nextLabel="Next month"
        onPrevious={calendar.previous}
        onNext={calendar.next}
      />
      <CalendarWeekdays start={calendar.visibleRange.start.toPlainDate()} />
      <CalendarGrid>
        {month.weeks.map((week) => (
          <CalendarRow key={week[0].id}>
            {week.map((day) => (
              <CalendarCell
                key={day.id}
                date={day.date}
                current={day.isCurrentMonth}
                today={day.isToday}
              >
                {day.items.map((event) => (
                  <CalendarEvent key={event.id}>{event.title}</CalendarEvent>
                ))}
              </CalendarCell>
            ))}
          </CalendarRow>
        ))}
      </CalendarGrid>
    </Calendar>
  );
}
```

### calendar-ui.tsx

```tsx
import type { Temporal } from "@js-temporal/polyfill";
import type { ButtonHTMLAttributes, ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "./cn";

export function Button({
  active,
  className,
  ...props
}: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & { active?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-pressed={active}
      className={cn(
        "rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-fd-muted-foreground transition-colors",
        "hover:bg-fd-muted hover:text-fd-foreground",
        "focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-400",
        active && "bg-fd-primary text-fd-primary-foreground",
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export function Calendar({
  children,
  size = "month",
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  size?: "month" | "day" | "wide";
}) {
  const widths = { month: "max-w-2xl", day: "max-w-md", wide: "max-w-3xl" };
  return <div className={cn("w-full min-w-0", widths[size])}>{children}</div>;
}

export function CalendarToolbar({
  title,
  onPrevious,
  onNext,
  previousLabel,
  nextLabel,
  children,
}: {
  title: string;
  onPrevious: () => void;
  onNext: () => void;
  previousLabel: string;
  nextLabel: string;
  children?: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="mb-4 space-y-3">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <Button aria-label={previousLabel} onClick={onPrevious}>
          ←
        </Button>
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{title}</h2>
        <Button aria-label={nextLabel} onClick={onNext}>
          →
        </Button>
      </div>
      {children && <div className="flex justify-center gap-1">{children}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function CalendarWeekdays({ start }: { start: Temporal.PlainDate }) {
  const days = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, index) =>
    start.add({ days: index }).toLocaleString("en-US", { weekday: "short" }),
  );
  return (
    <div className="mb-2 grid grid-cols-7">
      {days.map((day) => (
        <div key={day} className="py-2 text-center text-xs text-fd-muted-foreground">
          {day}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function CalendarGrid({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return <div className="space-y-1">{children}</div>;
}

export function CalendarRow({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1">{children}</div>;
}

export function CalendarCell({
  date,
  current = true,
  today = false,
  children,
}: {
  date: Temporal.PlainDate;
  current?: boolean;
  today?: boolean;
  children?: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "min-h-20 rounded-lg border p-2",
        current ? "border-fd-border bg-fd-card" : "border-transparent opacity-40",
      )}
    >
      <span
        className={cn(
          "inline-grid size-6 place-items-center rounded-full text-sm",
          today && "bg-sky-500 font-medium text-white",
        )}
      >
        {date.day}
      </span>
      {children && <div className="mt-1 space-y-1">{children}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function CalendarEvent({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="truncate rounded bg-sky-500 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-white">
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function CalendarTimeline({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="max-h-96 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border border-fd-border">
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function CalendarTimeRow({ label, children }: { label: string; children?: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="grid min-h-12 grid-cols-[4.5rem_1fr] border-b border-fd-border last:border-b-0">
      <div className="border-r border-fd-border p-2 text-xs text-fd-muted-foreground">
        {label}
      </div>
      <div className="min-w-0 p-2">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

type WeekHeaderDay = {
  id: string;
  date: Temporal.PlainDate;
  isToday: boolean;
};

export function CalendarWeekHeader({ days }: { days: readonly WeekHeaderDay[] }) {
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-[3.75rem_repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr))] border-b border-fd-border bg-fd-muted/20">
      <div />
      {days.map((day) => (
        <div key={day.id} className="border-l border-fd-border p-2 text-center">
          <div className="text-xs text-fd-muted-foreground">
            {day.date.toLocaleString("en", { weekday: "short" })}
          </div>
          <div
            className={cn(
              "mx-auto mt-1 grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full",
              day.isToday && "bg-sky-500 text-white",
            )}
          >
            {day.date.day}
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function CalendarTimeGrid({
  header,
  children,
}: {
  header: ReactNode;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-fd-border">
      {header}
      <div className="max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function CalendarTimeGridRow({
  label,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-[3.75rem_repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr))] border-b border-fd-border last:border-b-0">
      <div className="border-r border-fd-border bg-fd-muted/10 p-2 text-xs text-fd-muted-foreground">
        {label}
      </div>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function CalendarTimeCell({ children }: { children?: ReactNode }) {
  return <div className="min-h-12 min-w-0 border-l border-fd-border p-1">{children}</div>;
}
```

### mock-data.ts

```ts
import { Temporal } from '@js-temporal/polyfill';

export type Event = {
  id: string;
  date: string;
  start?: string; // ISO ZonedDateTime string for time-aware events
  title: string;
};

const titles = [
  'Standup',
  'Planning',
  'Review',
  'Launch',
  'Demo',
  'Retro',
  'Sprint',
  'Deploy',
  'Sync',
  'Lunch',
];

// Generate events around the current date so calendars are never empty
function generateEvents(): Event[] {
  const timeZone = Temporal.Now.timeZoneId();
  const today = Temporal.Now.plainDateISO();
  const events: Event[] = [];

  // Generate events for -2 months to +2 months
  for (let monthOffset = -2; monthOffset <= 2; monthOffset++) {
    const month = today.add({ months: monthOffset });
    const daysInMonth = month.daysInMonth;

    // Add events on various days throughout each month
    const eventDays = [3, 5, 8, 12, 15, 18, 22, 25, 28].filter((d) => d <= daysInMonth);
    eventDays.forEach((day, i) => {
      const date = month.with({ day });
      events.push({
        id: `${monthOffset}-${day}`,
        date: date.toString(),
        title: titles[(monthOffset + 2 + i) % titles.length],
      });
    });
  }

  // Add 2 events for today at specific times (9 AM and 11 AM - visible in week view's first 5 slots)
  const todayAt9am = today.toZonedDateTime({
    timeZone,
    plainTime: Temporal.PlainTime.from('09:00'),
  });
  const todayAt11am = today.toZonedDateTime({
    timeZone,
    plainTime: Temporal.PlainTime.from('11:00'),
  });

  events.push({
    id: 'today-9am',
    date: today.toString(),
    start: todayAt9am.toString(),
    title: 'Team Sync',
  });

  events.push({
    id: 'today-11am',
    date: today.toString(),
    start: todayAt11am.toString(),
    title: 'Project Review',
  });

  // Add extra events around today for day/week views (excluding today itself)
  // Give them times within the 8-18 range so they show in time slots
  for (let dayOffset = -3; dayOffset <= 3; dayOffset++) {
    if (dayOffset === 0) continue; // Skip today, we already added specific events
    const date = today.add({ days: dayOffset });
    const hour = 9 + Math.abs(dayOffset); // Vary the time: 10, 11, 12 AM
    const startTime = date.toZonedDateTime({
      timeZone,
      plainTime: Temporal.PlainTime.from({ hour, minute: 0 }),
    });
    events.push({
      id: `nearby-${dayOffset}`,
      date: date.toString(),
      start: startTime.toString(),
      title: titles[(dayOffset + 3) % titles.length],
    });
  }

  return events;
}

export const events = generateEvents();

export async function fetchEvents(
  start: Temporal.ZonedDateTime,
  end: Temporal.ZonedDateTime,
): Promise<Event[]> {
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));
  return events.filter((e) => {
    const date = Temporal.PlainDate.from(e.date);
    return (
      Temporal.PlainDate.compare(date, start.toPlainDate()) >= 0 &&
      Temporal.PlainDate.compare(date, end.toPlainDate()) < 0
    );
  });
}

// Get the browser's timezone for consistent time handling
const browserTimeZone = Temporal.Now.timeZoneId();

export const accessor = {
  getDate: (e: Event) => Temporal.PlainDate.from(e.date),
  getStart: (e: Event) => {
    if (e.start) {
      return Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from(e.start);
    }
    // Default to midnight in browser timezone for events without specific time
    return Temporal.PlainDate.from(e.date).toZonedDateTime({
      timeZone: browserTimeZone,
      plainTime: Temporal.PlainTime.from('00:00'),
    });
  },
};
```

### cn.ts

```ts
import { twMerge } from 'tailwind-merge';

export function cn(...inputs: (string | undefined | null | false)[]) {
  return twMerge(inputs.filter(Boolean).join(' '));
}
```

### date-picker.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { useCalendarView, useCreateCalendar } from '@gobrand/react-calendar';
import {
  Button,
  Calendar,
  CalendarCell,
  CalendarGrid,
  CalendarRow,
  CalendarToolbar,
  CalendarWeekdays,
} from './calendar-ui';

export function DatePickerExample() {
  const calendar = useCreateCalendar({ views: { month: true } });
  const month = useCalendarView({ calendar, view: 'month' });

  return (
    <Calendar size="month">
      <CalendarToolbar
        title={calendar.title()}
        previousLabel="Previous month"
        nextLabel="Next month"
        onPrevious={calendar.previous}
        onNext={calendar.next}
      />
      <CalendarWeekdays start={calendar.visibleRange.start.toPlainDate()} />
      <CalendarGrid>
        {month.weeks.map((week) => (
          <CalendarRow key={week[0].id}>
            {week.map((day) => (
              <CalendarCell
                key={day.id}
                date={day.date}
                current={day.isCurrentMonth}
                today={day.isToday}
              >
                <Button
                  active={day.date.equals(calendar.date)}
                  aria-label={`Select ${day.date.toString()}`}
                  onClick={() => calendar.setDate(day.date)}
                >
                  Select
                </Button>
              </CalendarCell>
            ))}
          </CalendarRow>
        ))}
      </CalendarGrid>
    </Calendar>
  );
}
```

### week-view.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { Temporal } from '@js-temporal/polyfill';
import { useCreateCalendar } from '@gobrand/react-calendar';
import {
  Calendar,
  CalendarCell,
  CalendarEvent,
  CalendarGrid,
  CalendarRow,
  CalendarTimeCell,
  CalendarTimeGrid,
  CalendarTimeGridRow,
  CalendarToolbar,
  CalendarWeekHeader,
  CalendarWeekdays,
} from './calendar-ui';
import { accessor, events } from './mock-data';

export function SimpleWeekExample() {
  const calendar = useCreateCalendar({
    views: { week: true },
    items: events,
    getDate: accessor.getDate,
  });
  const week = calendar.activeView;

  return (
    <Calendar size="month">
      <CalendarToolbar
        title={calendar.title()}
        previousLabel="Previous week"
        nextLabel="Next week"
        onPrevious={calendar.previous}
        onNext={calendar.next}
      />
      <CalendarWeekdays start={calendar.visibleRange.start.toPlainDate()} />
      <CalendarGrid>
        <CalendarRow>
          {week.days.map((day) => (
            <CalendarCell key={day.id} date={day.date} today={day.isToday}>
              {day.items.map((event) => (
                <CalendarEvent key={event.id}>{event.title}</CalendarEvent>
              ))}
            </CalendarCell>
          ))}
        </CalendarRow>
      </CalendarGrid>
    </Calendar>
  );
}

export function WeekSlotsExample() {
  const calendar = useCreateCalendar({
    views: {
      week: {
        dayStart: Temporal.PlainTime.from('00:00'),
        dayEnd: Temporal.PlainTime.from('23:59:59.999999999'),
        slotDuration: Temporal.Duration.from({ hours: 1 }),
      },
    },
    items: events,
    getDate: accessor.getDate,
    getStart: accessor.getStart,
  });
  const week = calendar.activeView;
  const timeSlots = week.days[0]?.timeSlots ?? [];

  return (
    <Calendar size="wide">
      <CalendarToolbar
        title={calendar.title()}
        previousLabel="Previous week"
        nextLabel="Next week"
        onPrevious={calendar.previous}
        onNext={calendar.next}
      />
      <CalendarTimeGrid header={<CalendarWeekHeader days={week.days} />}>
        {timeSlots.map((slot, slotIndex) => (
          <CalendarTimeGridRow
            key={slot.id}
            label={slot.time.toLocaleString('en', { hour: 'numeric' })}
          >
            {week.days.map((day) => {
              const daySlot = day.timeSlots[slotIndex];
              return (
                <CalendarTimeCell key={day.id}>
                  {daySlot?.items.map((event) => (
                    <CalendarEvent key={event.id}>{event.title}</CalendarEvent>
                  ))}
                </CalendarTimeCell>
              );
            })}
          </CalendarTimeGridRow>
        ))}
      </CalendarTimeGrid>
    </Calendar>
  );
}
```

### day-view.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { Temporal } from '@js-temporal/polyfill';
import { useCreateCalendar } from '@gobrand/react-calendar';
import {
  Calendar,
  CalendarEvent,
  CalendarTimeline,
  CalendarTimeRow,
  CalendarToolbar,
} from './calendar-ui';
import { accessor, events } from './mock-data';

export function DayViewExample() {
  const calendar = useCreateCalendar({
    views: {
      day: {
        dayStart: Temporal.PlainTime.from('00:00'),
        dayEnd: Temporal.PlainTime.from('23:59:59.999999999'),
        slotDuration: Temporal.Duration.from({ hours: 1 }),
      },
    },
    items: events,
    getDate: accessor.getDate,
    getStart: accessor.getStart,
  });
  const day = calendar.activeView;

  return (
    <Calendar size="day">
      <CalendarToolbar
        title={calendar.title()}
        previousLabel="Previous day"
        nextLabel="Next day"
        onPrevious={calendar.previous}
        onNext={calendar.next}
      />
      <CalendarTimeline>
        {day.timeSlots.map((slot) => (
          <CalendarTimeRow
            key={slot.id}
            label={slot.time.toLocaleString('en-US', { timeStyle: 'short' })}
          >
            {slot.items.map((event) => (
              <CalendarEvent key={event.id}>{event.title}</CalendarEvent>
            ))}
          </CalendarTimeRow>
        ))}
      </CalendarTimeline>
    </Calendar>
  );
}
```

### multi-view.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  type DayView,
  type MonthView,
  type WeekView,
  useCreateCalendar,
} from '@gobrand/react-calendar';
import {
  Button,
  Calendar,
  CalendarCell,
  CalendarEvent,
  CalendarGrid,
  CalendarRow,
  CalendarToolbar,
  CalendarWeekdays,
} from './calendar-ui';
import { accessor, events, type Event } from './mock-data';

export function MultiViewExample() {
  const calendar = useCreateCalendar({
    views: { month: true, week: true, day: true },
    items: events,
    getDate: accessor.getDate,
  });
  const view = calendar.activeView;

  return (
    <Calendar size="month">
      <CalendarToolbar
        title={calendar.title()}
        previousLabel="Previous date range"
        nextLabel="Next date range"
        onPrevious={calendar.previous}
        onNext={calendar.next}
      >
        {calendar.viewNames.map((name) => (
          <Button key={name} active={calendar.view === name} onClick={() => calendar.setView(name)}>
            {name[0].toUpperCase() + name.slice(1)}
          </Button>
        ))}
      </CalendarToolbar>
      {calendar.view !== 'day' && (
        <CalendarWeekdays start={calendar.visibleRange.start.toPlainDate()} />
      )}
      {view.name === 'month' && <MonthCalendar month={view} />}
      {view.name === 'week' && <WeekCalendar week={view} />}
      {view.name === 'day' && <DayCalendar day={view} />}
    </Calendar>
  );
}

function MonthCalendar({ month }: { month: MonthView<Event> }) {
  return (
    <CalendarGrid>
      {month.weeks.map((week) => (
        <CalendarRow key={week[0].id}>
          {week.map((day) => (
            <CalendarCell
              key={day.id}
              date={day.date}
              current={day.isCurrentMonth}
              today={day.isToday}
            >
              {day.items.map((event) => (
                <CalendarEvent key={event.id}>{event.title}</CalendarEvent>
              ))}
            </CalendarCell>
          ))}
        </CalendarRow>
      ))}
    </CalendarGrid>
  );
}

function WeekCalendar({ week }: { week: WeekView<Event> }) {
  return (
    <CalendarGrid>
      <CalendarRow>
        {week.days.map((day) => (
          <CalendarCell key={day.id} date={day.date} today={day.isToday}>
            {day.items.map((event) => (
              <CalendarEvent key={event.id}>{event.title}</CalendarEvent>
            ))}
          </CalendarCell>
        ))}
      </CalendarRow>
    </CalendarGrid>
  );
}

function DayCalendar({ day }: { day: DayView<Event> }) {
  return (
    <CalendarGrid>
      <CalendarCell date={day.date} today={day.isToday}>
        {day.items.length > 0
          ? day.items.map((event) => <CalendarEvent key={event.id}>{event.title}</CalendarEvent>)
          : 'No events'}
      </CalendarCell>
    </CalendarGrid>
  );
}
```

### suspense-month.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { Suspense } from 'react';
import {
  CalendarProvider,
  useCalendar,
  useCalendarView,
  useCreateCalendar,
} from '@gobrand/react-calendar';
import { useSuspenseQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import {
  Calendar,
  CalendarCell,
  CalendarEvent,
  CalendarGrid,
  CalendarRow,
  CalendarToolbar,
  CalendarWeekdays,
} from './calendar-ui';
import { accessor, fetchEvents } from './mock-data';

export function SuspenseMonthExample() {
  const calendar = useCreateCalendar({ views: { month: true } });

  return (
    <CalendarProvider calendar={calendar}>
      <MonthCalendar />
    </CalendarProvider>
  );
}

function MonthCalendar() {
  const calendar = useCalendar();

  return (
    <Calendar size="month">
      <CalendarToolbar
        title={calendar.title()}
        previousLabel="Previous month"
        nextLabel="Next month"
        onPrevious={calendar.previous}
        onNext={calendar.next}
      />
      <CalendarWeekdays start={calendar.visibleRange.start.toPlainDate()} />
      <Suspense fallback={<div>Loading events…</div>}>
        <MonthContent />
      </Suspense>
    </Calendar>
  );
}

function MonthContent() {
  const calendar = useCalendar();
  const { start, end } = calendar.visibleRange;
  const { data: events } = useSuspenseQuery({
    queryKey: ['events', start.toString(), end.toString()],
    queryFn: () => fetchEvents(start, end),
  });
  const month = useCalendarView({
    view: 'month',
    items: events,
    getDate: accessor.getDate,
  });

  return (
    <CalendarGrid>
      {month.weeks.map((week) => (
        <CalendarRow key={week[0].id}>
          {week.map((day) => (
            <CalendarCell
              key={day.id}
              date={day.date}
              current={day.isCurrentMonth}
              today={day.isToday}
            >
              {day.items.map((event) => (
                <CalendarEvent key={event.id}>{event.title}</CalendarEvent>
              ))}
            </CalendarCell>
          ))}
        </CalendarRow>
      ))}
    </CalendarGrid>
  );
}
```

### suspense-standalone.tsx

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { SuspenseMonthExample } from './suspense-month';

export function StandaloneSuspenseMonth() {
  const [client] = useState(() => new QueryClient());
  return (
    <QueryClientProvider client={client}>
      <SuspenseMonthExample />
    </QueryClientProvider>
  );
}
```
